Char Kway Teow.note: Prawns = crustaceans; cockles = molluscs; egg; light and dark soy sauce = soy + gluten (rice noodles themselves have none); lap cheong = pork; fried in pork lard = not vegetarian, not halal. Spicy = 2.

Char Kway Teow Special.note: As Char Kway Teow with duck egg = egg; prawns, cockles; soy sauce; lap cheong and lard = not halal. Spicy = 2.

Vegetarian Char Kway Teow.note: Chicken egg; soy sauce = soy + gluten; vegetable oil; chilli paste stated without shrimp. Vegetarian, not vegan (egg). Halal by ingredients at a 'none' branch. Spicy = 2.

Fried Mee.note: Wheat egg noodles = gluten, egg; prawns; soy sauce; fried in pork lard = not vegetarian, not halal. A little chilli = 1.

Fried Bihun.note: Prawns; egg; light soy = soy + gluten; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (rule g); fried in pork lard = not vegetarian, not halal. Not spicy = 0.

Wat Tan Hor.note: Egg gravy; prawns; squid = molluscs; fish cake = fish; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (rule g). Vegetable oil, no pork: halal by ingredients. Not spicy itself, but pickled green chilli on the side = 1 (condiment rule).

Penang Hokkien Mee.note: Yellow noodles = gluten; boiled egg; prawns and prawn-head broth = crustaceans; pork ribs, sliced pork and lard = not halal. Spicy = 2.

Kway Teow Th'ng.note: Fish balls and fish cake = fish (assumed wheat-free, v3); pork bone broth = not halal. Not spicy.

Fish Ball Soup.note: Fish balls = fish; clear chicken broth. Halal by ingredients. Not spicy.

Oyster Omelette.note: Oysters = molluscs; eggs; sweet potato starch has no gluten; pork lard = not halal. Chilli sauce on the side = 1. Supper only.

Fried Carrot Cake (Black).note: Radish and rice flour cake (no wheat); sweet dark soy sauce = soy + gluten; egg; fried in pork lard = not vegetarian, not halal. A little chilli = 1.

Fried Carrot Cake (White).note: Egg; fish sauce = fish; no soy sauce; fried in pork lard = not vegetarian, not halal. Not spicy. Sold out.

Chai Poh Omelette.note: Egg; preserved radish; fried in pork lard = not vegetarian, not halal. Not spicy.

Lor Bak.note: Beancurd skin and fried tofu = soy; prawn fritter = crustaceans + wheat flour = gluten; egg in the gravy; pork = not halal. Chilli sauce = 1. Supper only.

Fresh Popiah.note: Wheat skin = gluten; jicama braised with dried shrimp = crustaceans; egg; sweet sauce with soy sauce = soy + gluten. No pork or lard stated: halal by ingredients. Chilli paste with no heat word = 1.

Otak-Otak.note: Mackerel = fish; egg; belacan = crustaceans; coconut milk is not milk. Spicy = 2.

Fried Wonton.note: Wheat and egg wrappers; prawn = crustaceans; pork = not halal. Sweet chilli sauce = 1.

Fried Tau Kwa.note: Tofu = soy; crushed peanuts. Sweet chilli sauce = 1. Vegan as tagged.

Kopi O.note: No milk added, but beans roasted with butter = milk (rule o): vegetarian, not vegan.

Nutmeg Juice.note: Nutmeg fruit is a spice, not a regulated tree nut. No allergen.
